title: Study: Half of Filipinos reject 'resilience' narrative amid economic woes
summary: One in two Filipinos reject the long-romanticized narrative of resilience, viewing it less as a badge of honor and more as an expectation to endure hardship amid mounting economic pressures,…

blocks.text: One in two Filipinos reject the long-romanticized narrative of resilience, viewing it less as a badge of honor and more as an expectation to endure hardship amid mounting economic pressures, according to a consumer sentiment study released Friday.
